title: Improved Regret Bounds for Gaussian Process Upper Confidence Bound in Bayesian Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2506.01393v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper addresses the Bayesian optimization problem (also referred to as the Bayesian setting of the Gaussian process bandit), where the learner seeks to minimize the regret under a function drawn from a known Gaussian process (GP). Under a Mat\'ern kernel with a certain degree of smoothness, we show that the Gaussian process upper confidence bound (GP-UCB) algorithm achieves $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ cumulative regret with high probability. Furthermore, our analysis yields $O(\sqrt{T \ln^2 T})$ regret under a squared exponential kernel. These results fill the gap between the existing regret upper bound for GP-UCB and the best-known bound provided by Scarlett (2018). The key idea in our proof is to capture the concentration behavior of the input sequence realized by GP-UCB, enabling a more refined analysis of the GP's information gain.

translated_title: 贝叶斯优化中高斯过程上置信界算法的更优遗憾界
translated_abstract: 本文研究贝叶斯优化问题（也称为高斯过程老虎机的贝叶斯设定），其中学习者的目标是在从已知高斯过程（GP）中抽取的函数下最小化遗憾。在具有一定平滑度的Matérn核条件下，我们证明高斯过程上置信界（GP-UCB）算法以高概率实现$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$的累积遗憾。此外，我们的分析在平方指数核下得到了$O(\sqrt{T \ln^2 T})$的遗憾。这些结果填补了GP-UCB现有遗憾上界与Scarlett（2018）给出的最佳已知界之间的差距。我们证明的关键思想是刻画GP-UCB所产生的输入序列的集中行为，从而实现对高斯过程信息增益更为精细的分析。
tldr: 本文通过刻画GP-UCB输入序列的集中行为以更精细地分析高斯过程信息增益，证明了GP-UCB在Matérn核下可达到$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$、在平方指数核下可达到$O(\sqrt{T \ln^2 T})$的遗憾界，填补了与已知最优遗憾界之间的差距。
en_tdlr: By capturing the concentration behavior of the input sequence generated by GP-UCB to enable a refined analysis of the GP's information gain, this paper proves that GP-UCB achieves $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret under Matérn kernels and $O(\sqrt{T \ln^2 T})$ regret under squared exponential kernels, closing the gap between existing bounds and the best-known regret bounds.
